```yaml
name: UI Watchlists RC Gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
    paths:
      - 'tldw_Server_API/**'
      - 'e2e/**'
      - '.github/workflows/ui-watchlists-rc-gate.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  lint-security:
    name: Security Lint (Bandit)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install bandit

      - name: Run Bandit security lint
        run: |
          bandit -r \
            tldw_Server_API/app/api/v1/endpoints/media/ingest_jobs.py \
            tldw_Server_API/app/core/Jobs/manager.py \
            -f json \
            -o /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json
          
          # Check for findings (exit 1 if findings > 0)
          if [ -f /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json ]; then
            findings=$(cat /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json | python -c "import sys, json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); print(len(data.get('results', [])))")
            if [ "$findings" -gt 0 ]; then
              echo "::error::Bandit found $findings security issues."
              cat /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json
              exit 1
            else
              echo "No security findings."
            fi
          fi

  test-integration-unit:
    name: Unit & Integration Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      # Assuming standard DB requirements for tldw_server, adjust if necessary
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: tldw_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          # Install project dependencies. Adjust based on actual requirements file location.
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f tldw_Server_API/requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r tldw_Server_API/requirements.txt; fi
          pip install pytest pytest-asyncio

      - name: Run Unit & Integration Tests
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/tldw_test
          TLDW_API_KEY: THIS-IS-A-SECURE-KEY-123-FAKE-KEY
        run: |
          python -m pytest -q \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_batch_cancel.py \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_events_stream.py \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/unit/test_ingest_jobs_batch_lookup.py

  test-e2e:
    name: E2E Tests (Playwright)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint-security, test-integration-unit]
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f tldw_Server_API/requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r tldw_Server_API/requirements.txt; fi

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          npm install
          npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Start Server for E2E
        run: |
          # Start the server in the background
          # Adjust the command to match your actual server startup command
          python -m uvicorn tldw_Server_API.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 &
          sleep 5 # Wait for server to start

      - name: Run E2E Tests
        env:
          TLDW_E2E_SERVER_URL: 127.0.0.1:8000
          TLDW_E2E_API_KEY: THIS-IS-A-SECURE-KEY-123-FAKE-KEY
        run: |
          npx playwright test e2e/workflows/media-ingest.spec.ts \
            --grep "should cancel quick ingest mid-process with confirmation" \
            --reporter=line

      - name: Upload Playwright Report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30
```
